title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Banana Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Banana Ice delivers the smooth and creamy taste of ripe Banana with a fresh, frosty exhale. The natural sweetness of Banana is complemented by a refreshing wave of coolness for an endlessly satisfying all-day vape. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides a smooth throat hit and optimised nicotine absorption. With a 50/50 VG/PG ratio, it ensures well-defined flavour with subtle vapour production, making it ideal for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing familiar and satisfying flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle is equipped with a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for added convenience.
